Cross-fitted scan inputs for any learner

Source: R/scan_ci.R
crossfit_inputs.Rd

Splits the rows into folds and predicts \(\hat\eta_{\mathrm{obs}}\) and \(\hat r\) for each fold from models fitted on the other folds, as sharp_scan_ci() requires. The learner is yours: fit_eta and fit_r are functions that fit on a training frame and return probabilities for new rows. fit_eta receives only the observed rows of the training folds.

Usage

crossfit_inputs(
  data,
  response,
  fit_eta,
  fit_r,
  folds = 5L,
  seed = NULL,
  clip = 1e-06
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with all rows, observed and unobserved.

response

Name of the response indicator column (0/1 or logical).

fit_eta

function(train, newdata) returning \(P(Y = 1 \mid X, R = 1)\) for newdata; train holds observed rows.

fit_r

function(train, newdata) returning \(P(R = 1 \mid X)\).

folds

Number of folds. Default 5.

seed

Optional seed for the fold assignment.

clip

Predictions are clipped to [clip, 1 - clip]. Default 1e-6.

Value

A list with eta_obs, r (one per row of data) and fold.

See also

sharp_scan_ci()
